parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated.

parameters.name: ConsumerGroupName
parameters.description: The name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. We recommend that you use a descriptive name for easy identification.

parameters.name: ConsumerGroupPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the consumer group account.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

parameters.name: ConsumerGroupUserName
parameters.description:
The account of the consumer group.

The account can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The account can be up to 16 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SubscriptionInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID.
